description: Core-first ontology mapping profile for the canonical German Gymnasium mathematics release model. Goal semantics are joined exclusively from the separately reviewed, fingerprint-bound ledger; this profile contains no goal-ID list and forbids title or ID-prefix inference.

sourceFingerprint.byteFormula: sourceFingerprint = 'sha256:' + lowercaseHex(SHA-256(UTF-8(skillpilot-canonical-json-v1({'domain': domain, 'fields': [record(pointer) for pointer in pointers]})))); record(pointer) = {'path': pointer, 'state': 'missing'} when absent, otherwise {'path': pointer, 'state': 'value', 'value': normalizedValue}; the sha256: prefix is not part of the hashed bytes

curricularAtomic.notes: An assessable subject-specific competency is represented as the Core Fachbezogene Kompetenzspezifikation.

curricularArea.notes: A curricular subject cluster is represented as the Core CE-Bereich.

practiceAssessment.notes: Practice and assessment endpoints carry runtime task, scoring, and autonomy semantics that the curriculum Core does not define.

programStructure.notes: Learner-facing program navigation nodes are not asserted as curricular competency areas; Core program-unit references are mapped separately.

memory.notes: SRS deck ownership and due-state behavior are SkillPilot runtime semantics.

runtimeSupport.notes: Pure runtime grouping nodes are explicitly excluded from false curricular-area assertions.

orientation.notes: Motivational and learner-orientation nodes are application navigation content rather than assessable curricular competencies.

curriculumIdentity.condition: Always bind mathematics and Gymnasium through the pinned KIM individuals; retain the canonical cross-jurisdiction landscape identity in the application profile without falsely asserting one state-specific Lehrplan.
curriculumIdentity.notes: The Core carries subject and school-type semantics; the stable SkillPilot landscape identity remains an application concern.

program.notes: The canonical multi-state program root is a runtime structure and is not asserted as one state-specific Core curriculum.

stage.condition: programUnit.kind equals stage and shortLabel resolves through stageLookup
stage.notes: The Core school-stage individual is referenced explicitly while the authored program-unit record stays losslessly reconstructible.

year.condition: programUnit.kind equals year and numeric order resolves through yearLookup
year.notes: Year units reference the matching Core Jahrgangsstufe individual; authored labels, hierarchy, and order remain in the application record.

phase.notes: E and Q1-Q4 cannot be assigned to one Core G8/G9 phase individual without a resolved duration context, so the canonical cross-duration phase remains explicit application structure.

processCompetencyCatalog.condition: Catalog and goal references use stable competency IDs; referenceRole distinguishes authored competencyRefs from dimension-derived process competency references.
processCompetencyCatalog.notes: Process competency entries use the Core Bistas process-area class and Core CE references; the application role preserves the exact source field.

titlesAndDescriptions.condition: Use language-tagged Core title and description text entities for curricular resources and the landscape; application-only nodes retain equivalent language-tagged fallback text without a false Core class assertion.
titlesAndDescriptions.notes: The containing profile preserves the authored field and language so title and description resources reconstruct unambiguously.

contains.condition: Always emit the positioned authored edge; additionally emit BFO has-part only when both reviewed semantic kinds make curricular parthood safe.
contains.notes: The Core projection is additive and never substitutes for direct-edge identity or authored order.

requires.condition: Always emit the positioned authored edge; additionally emit a Core didactic-prerequisite reference when source and target are reviewed curricularAtomic or curricularArea resources.
requires.notes: Inferred Core references do not create or reorder authored prerequisites.

visualReferences.condition: All resource links retain positioned application metadata; a curricular goal visualization additionally uses a Core CE reference to the image sidecar.
visualReferences.notes: External tools remain soft runtime links and do not become embedded binary dependencies.

compositionViews.condition: Composition views are explicit learner-facing runtime projections and never redefine canonical curricular parthood.
compositionViews.notes: Scope, structure labels, goal references, and child order are reconstructed from the application profile.

memoryCards.condition: SRS decks and cards are emitted only for goals reviewed as memory and preserve card order exactly.
memoryCards.notes: The curriculum Core does not define SRS scheduling or deck runtime semantics.

assessments.condition: Assessment data is allowed only on goals reviewed as practiceAssessment and remains a bounded owner subtree. Scoring steps use the registry-authoritative Core position predicate lp:LP_0000460; application-only nested lists use sp:order where registered.
assessments.notes: Task, solution, scoring, and review-state semantics are application data rather than curricular Core claims.

authoredOrder.condition: Every runtime-observable list is represented by unique contiguous zero-based positions independent of RDF statement order. The field-semantics registry selects lp:LP_0000460 or sp:order for each ordered lane.
authoredOrder.notes: Order is an explicit reconstruction contract; the field-semantics registry is authoritative for each lane's position predicate. Unordered Core projections are never the authoritative carrier.

officialSources.condition: The 52 documents with semanticType curriculum are represented as Core Lehrplan LP_0000438 with Core titles; the 3 supplemental documents remain sp:OfficialSourceDocument with rdfs:label. Canonical URLs use the domain-free Core URI property in both cases, while collection grouping, semantic type, and an optional distinct landing URL remain exact application evidence.
officialSources.notes: The hash-bound publication profile classifies each authored role explicitly as curriculum or supplemental-source; unknown and unused roles are rejected. The resulting semanticType drives the RDF construction without title, jurisdiction, or URL heuristics. Stable source identities and publication grouping are preserved without repository-local paths.

sourceGoalReferences.condition: Every reviewed source goal is represented conservatively as the generic Core Curriculares Element LP_0000261 with Core title and description records; exact source text, document join, locator, optional classification, and split lineage remain publication-evidence extensions.
sourceGoalReferences.notes: No source-goal competency subtype is inferred from extracted wording. Its official URL is obtained through the stable sourceDocumentId join to an officialSources record, which may be either a Core Lehrplan or an application-level supplemental document according to semanticType.

sourceMappings.condition: Every reviewed exact or partial source-to-canonical edge is a Core CE-Verweis LP_0030065 linked from its source by LP_0030071 and to its canonical goal by LP_0030072; exact-versus-partial granularity and the authored decision counts remain exact application predicates.
sourceMappings.notes: Authoring rationales, reviewers, timestamps, redundant rows, and repository paths are deliberately absent from the release-facing mapping graph.

qualityEvidence.condition: Release quality records are evidence about current SkillPilot review lanes and never curricular elements, competencies, prerequisites, or Core source statements. Missing visualization goal IDs are publication-only soft references and are not traversed into the runtime dependency closure.
qualityEvidence.notes: Only release-facing decisions, fingerprints, and independent quality scope evidence are emitted. Status-redundant booleans and list-derived counts are regenerated instead of receiving RDF literals. Reviewer identity, timestamps, rationales, workbench paths, model triage, generated reports, and removed-card history remain authoring-only.
